Callout.Name: Speeding Stop Backup
Callout.Message: Officer on a stop requesting a second unit.
Callout.Advisory: Driver argumentative, single officer on scene.

Script.Line: I have one vehicle stopped and two occupants.
The driver is fine. It is the passenger who keeps reaching under the seat.
Second unit, come up on the offside.

Lines.Approach: He is arguing with one officer on the hard shoulder and it is getting louder.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
